test_CseAnnotationsAccumulator_nodp: test CseAnnotationsAccumulator with instances that have no DensePose annotations
test_CseAnnotationsAccumulator_sparsedp: test CseAnnotationsAccumulator with instances that have sparse DensePose annotations
test_CseAnnotationsAccumulator_fulldp: test CseAnnotationsAccumulator with instances that have full DensePose annotations
test_CseAnnotationsAccumulator_combined: test CseAnnotationsAccumulator with a combined mix of no, sparse, and full DensePose instances
